gripOrHq.title: Encryption Breakthrough
gripOrHq.rulesText: All code gates have +1 strength. When you score Encryption Breakthrough, reveal as many code gates as you wish. Then, gain [1] for each revealed or rezzed code gate.

gripOrHq.title: Genetics-Visionary Acquisition
gripOrHq.rulesText: Difficulty of Research agendas is reduced by 1.

gripOrHq.title: Encoder, Inc.
gripOrHq.rulesText: Code gates cost [1] less to rez while Encoder, Inc. is rezzed. All code gates have an additional "End the run" subroutine after all other subroutines.

gripOrHq.title: Corporate Coup
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Put [15] from the bank on Corporate Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Corporate Coup, if it has any bits.

gripOrHq.title: Political Coup
gripOrHq.rulesText:
Put [12] from the bank on Political Coup when you score it.
A: Take [3] from Political Coup, if it has any bits.

gripOrHq.title: Ball and Chain
gripOrHq.rulesText: [Subroutine] For the remainder of the run, Runner must pay [2] when encountering a piece of ice, in addition to any other costs, or end the run.

heapOrArchives.title: Chicago Branch
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A, [3]: Add two advancement counters to an installed card that can be advanced.

rig.title: Smarteye
rig.rulesText: Once during each run, you may expose a piece of unrezzed ice as you approach it. You may then jack out before the Corp decides whether to rez the ice.

rig.title: Self-Modifying Code
rig.rulesText: [T]: Search your stack for a program and install that program, if you can. Shuffle your stack afterwards. Use this ability only during a run.

root.title: Twenty-Four-Hour Surveillance
root.rulesText: During runs on this fort, Runner cannot use bits from stealth sources.
